units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:59">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵈ</cite> <he>כלי צ׳</he> a vessel with raised figures, v. <cite ref="C00225"><he>גָּדַל</he> II</cite>. Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵃ top [read:] <he>תבשיל שנתלקלה צוּרָתוֹ</he> a dish that has become defaced (looking repulsive).

<cite ref="Tosefta Zevahim 7:6">Tosef. Zeb. VII, 6</cite> <he>תעבר צוּרָתָהּ</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:9">Pes. VII, 9</cite>, a. e. <he>תעובר צוּרָתוֹ</he> let its appearance be gone, i.e. wait until the flesh looks disfigured by beginning decay.
<cite ref="Niddah 25b:52">Nidd. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>צוּרַת פנים</he> the shape of a face.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 54a:7">B. Bath. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>הצר צ׳ וכ׳</he> if one draws a figure in the ground (or on the wall) of the estate of a deceased proselyte (as a symbol of possession).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73:5">Gen. R. s. 73</cite> <he>עד שנשתנה צוּרָתָן</he> until their features had changed (beyond recognition).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:34">Num. R. s. 9</cite>, beg. <he>צורת הולד</he> the features of the child (born in adultery); <he>צ׳ הנואף</he> the features of the adulterer.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:3">Ab. Zar. III, 3</cite> <he>צורת חמה</he> a representation of the sun; <he>צ׳ דרקון</he> of a serpent (idolatrous emblems); a. fr.—Tosef. Meg. IV (III), 41, a. e. <he>המתרגם פסוק כצורתו</he> he who translates a Biblical verse as it is formed, i.e. word for word without regard to idiomatic differences.—
<cite ref="Taanit 16a:9">Taan. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אדם של צ׳</he> a stately person.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 9a:23">M. Kat. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>אנשים של צ׳</he> worthy men; Yalk. Joh. 31 <he>של צרות</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>צוּרוֹת</he>. Y. Ab. Zar. III, beg. 42ᵇ; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:1">Tosef. Sabb. XVII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 18:1">XVIII</cite>), 1 <he>כתב המהלך תחת הצ׳ וכ׳</he> an inscription under paintings or busts; <cite ref="Shabbat 149a:13">Sabb. 149ᵃ</cite> <he>הצורה</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:34">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>צ׳ ביתך שחורות וכ׳</he> are the paintings in thy house portraits of black or of white persons? (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73:10">Gen. R. s. 73</cite> <he>מראות</he>); a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 72:5">Yalk. Gen. 72</cite> <he>צורות היאור</he>, v. <cite ref="R00613"><he>צִנּוֹר</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 24:1">Gen. R. s. 24</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 29:16">Is. XXIX, 16</cite>) <he>גדול … שמדמין צ׳ ליוצרה</he> great (bold) is the power of the prophets who represent the Creator under the form of the creature (by ref. to <cite ref="Daniel 8:16">Dan. VIII, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Ezekiel 1:26">Ez. I, 26</cite>); a. fr.
